title: psrtype-arbeidsdokumenter — working documents behind psrtype-samfyring and kapregister
description: Supplementary working documents for two preregistered measurements of production-type labelling in the ENTSO-E Transparency Platform. This is not a standalone study: there is no new measurement here, no preregistration of its own, and no conclusion that does not appear elsewhere. It collects the files that carry figures cited by those two datasets and by two manuscripts, but that are not part of either dataset: the A75 reconciliation report with its control categories, the Danish coal/biomass time series and unit attribution, the Finnish plant-heterogeneity closure, the schema audit of parallel TimeSeries, the per-zone effect computation, the cross-product consistency test, the adjudication printouts before and after the curveType A03 step-curve correction, and the six scripts that produce those numbers. Deposited unchanged except that local file paths were replaced with relative names and that two documents carry a dated notice where a later run superseded their figures. Raw XML is not included; it is re-fetchable from the ENTSO-E API and too large to archive here. v1.0.1 corrects the CZ row of the residual table in EFFEKT-PER-SONE.md, which was computed at 252 GWh instead of the upper bound of 402 GWh.
